article.title: Covid dispatch from a relatively non-Straussian country
article.excerpt: Most people will end up contracting the coronavirus, the head of the Health Ministry’s advisory committee for infectious diseases predicted on Monday. “The [real] question is whether the infected person is vaccinated or not.
